scanners.name: Price entering a fresh demand zone
scanners.definition: The bar's low first touches the near line of a demand zone no candle has visited since it formed.
scanners.text: SDZoneEnter("demand", avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars)

params.name: avg_n
params.doc: Candles in the average range a candle is measured against.

params.name: leg_mult
params.doc: A leg candle's range is at least this multiple of the average range.

params.name: base_mult
params.doc: A base candle's range is at most this multiple of the average range.

params.name: out_mult
params.doc: The leg-out candle's range is at least this multiple of the average range (or ATR).

params.name: leg_body_pct
params.doc: A leg candle's body is at least this percent of its range.

params.name: base_body_pct
params.doc: A base candle's body is at most this percent of its range.

params.name: base_max
params.doc: At most this many base candles in a row.

params.name: out_ref
params.doc: What the leg-out is measured against: average (the average range) or atr.

params.name: edge
params.doc: The zone's near line: wick (the base's high or low) or body (the base's body top or bottom).

params.name: skip_flat_bars
params.doc: On: a flat candle (high equals low) is never counted as a base candle.

scanners.footer: Information and education only, not investment advice.
